results: Same product name, different strength → separate, clearly labelled products
Location permission denied → manual locality / PIN search still works
Old confirmation time → stale warning, never an invented out-of-stock status
Edit pharmacy profile → stock confirmation times unchanged

Pharmacy A edits Pharmacy B inventory → rejected, no database change
Visitor calls protected write endpoints → rejected (direct unauthorized calls)
Request expiry passes without cleanup → read/update logic treats it as expired
No medicine matches → honest empty state and no substitute claim
Pharmacy confirms availability → response time shown; no reservation guarantee
Duplicate inventory insertion → constraint prevents a second pharmacy/product row
Invalid / hostile input → validated or safely displayed; no raw database error
Unrelated user accesses request → private request details are not exposed
Catalogue entry archived → historical records remain interpretable
Full demonstration: register → admin approves → list → confirm → visitor searches → request → pharmacy responds → unauthorized edit rejected
Stock rules: only explicit actions refresh confirmation; reactivate keeps old time; status change confirms
CSRF: state-changing calls without a valid token are rejected
Login rate limiting, generic errors, session cookie flags
Admin workflow rules: transitions, mandatory reasons, catalogue duplicates, report review
Private request rules: duplicate pending blocked, rate limit, requests for hidden listings refused
Retention script deletes only old data (expiry does not depend on it)
